sources.title: Buchanania
sources.clean:
{{about|the genus of plants|the genus of sea snails|Buchanania (gastropod)}}

Buchanania is a genus of plants in the mango and cashew family Anacardiaceae, native to areas from India to southern China, and southwards to northern Australia and the western Pacific.{{R|GBIF|POWO}}

Description
This genus consists of trees with {{botanygloss|simple}}, unlobed leaves arranged alternately on the twigs. Flowers are produced in {{botanygloss|axil|axillary}} or terminal panicles. Flowers are bisexual, i.e. they have both male and female organs. They usually have 5 {{botanygloss|calyx}} lobes and 5 petals, sometimes 4 or 6, and are pale green to white. There are 10 stamens and 4–6 carpels, only one of which is fertile. Fruits are more or less lens-shaped drupes with a bony or woody {{botanygloss|endocarp}}, and contain a single seed.{{R|FOA|FGVP}} Unlike other genera in the family, Buchanania does not appear to cause contact dermatitis.{{R|BEAMAN|p=195}}

Taxonomy
The genus Buchanania was erected in 1801 by German botanist Kurt Polycarp Joachim Sprengel based on a collection of plant material by Francis Buchanan-Hamilton from what is now Myanmar. The genus was named after the collector.{{R|FOA|SPRENGEL}}

Distribution
The genus is native to areas from South and Southeast Asia, extending to northern Australia and the western Pacific. The full distribution is as follows:{{R|GBIF|POWO}}
 Indian subcontinent: Assam, Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, West Himalaya
 China & East Asia: China South-Central, Hainan, Taiwan, 
 Indo-China: Andaman Is., Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Nicobar Is., Thailand, Vietnam
 Malesia: Borneo, Jawa, Lesser Sunda Is., Malaya, Maluku, Philippines, Sulawesi, Sumatera
 Papuasia: Bismarck Archipelago, New Guinea, Solomon Is.
 Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, Western Australia
 Western Pacific: Caroline Is., Fiji, Samoa, Santa Cruz Is., Vanuatu

Species
{{As of|2024|04|21}}, Plants of the World Online recognises 26 species in the genus,{{R|POWO}} as follows:
Buchanania abrahamiana {{small|[[Ettickal Sukumaran Santhosh Kumar|E.S.S.Kumar]] & [[Sainudeen Muhammed Shareef|Shareef]]}} – India
Buchanania amboinensis {{small|[[Friedrich Anton Wilhelm Miquel|Miq.]]}} – Maluku Islands, New Guinea, Solomon Islands
Buchanania arborescens {{small|(Blume) Blume}} – India, Taiwan, tropical Asia, northern Australia, western Pacific
Buchanania attenuata {{small|[[Albert Charles Smith|A.C.Sm.]]}} – Santa Cruz Islands, Fiji
Buchanania axillaris {{small|([[Louis Auguste Joseph Desrousseaux|Desr.]]) [[Thennilapuram Parasuraman Ramamoorthy|Ramamoorthy]]}} – India, Sri Lanka
Buchanania barberi {{small|[[James Sykes Gamble|Gamble]]}} – India
Buchanania engleriana {{small|[[Georg Volkens|Volkens]]}} – Caroline Islands
Buchanania evrardii {{small|[[Marie Laure Tardieu|Tardieu]]}} – Cambodia
Buchanania ferruginea {{small|[[Adolf Engler|Engl.]]}} – India
Buchanania glabra {{small|[[Nathaniel Wallich|Wall.]] ex Engl.}} – India, Indo-China
Buchanania insignis {{small|Blume}} – Borneo, Philippines
Buchanania lanceolata {{small|[[Robert Wight|Wight]]}} – southwestern India, Myanmar
Buchanania lancifolia {{small|[[William Roxburgh|Roxb.]]}} – Andaman Islands, Bangladesh, Myanmar
Buchanania lanzan {{small|Spreng.}} – Indian subcontinent, southern China, Indo-China
Buchanania macrocarpa {{small|[[Carl Adolf Georg Lauterbach|Lauterb.]]}} – Maluku Islands, Papuasia
Buchanania mangoides {{small|[[Ferdinand von Mueller|F.Muell.]]}} – Queensland
Buchanania merrillii {{small|[[Erling Christophersen|Christoph.]]}} – Samoa
Buchanania microphylla {{small|Engl.}} – Hainan, Philippines
Buchanania nitida {{small|Engl.}} – Philippines, Maluku Islands
Buchanania obovata {{small|Engl.}} – northern Australia
Buchanania palawensis {{small|Lauterb.}} – Palau
Buchanania reticulata {{small|[[Henry Fletcher Hance|Hance]]}} – Indo-China
Buchanania sessifolia {{small|Blume}} – Assam, Indo-China, western Malesia
Buchanania siamensis {{small|Miq.}} – Indo-China
Buchanania splendens {{small|Miq.}} – Andaman Islands & Nicobar Islands, Sumatra, Borneo
Buchanania vitiensis {{small|Engl.}} – Fiji

Formerly placed here
The following names were previously recognised as species of Buchanania.
Buchanania cochinchinensis {{small|(Lour.) M.R.Almeida}} – now Glycosmis cochinchinensis {{small|(Lour.) Pierre ex Engl.}}{{R|cochinchinensis}}
Buchanania yunnanensis {{small|C.Y.Wu}} – now Spondias pinnata {{small|(L.f.) Kurz}}{{R|yunnanensis}}
Buchanania zeylanica {{small|Blume}} – now Mangifera zeylanica {{small|(Blume) Hook.f.}}{{R|zeylanica}}
